speaker: Doctor
text: I see you recently had acute sinusitis treated with antibiotics, yet now you have fatigue, flank pain, and fever. Could you tell me if you have noticed any changes in your urine color, frequency, or if you are experiencing nausea or vomiting?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you noticed any blood in your urine, burning during urination, or a change in the volume of your urine output?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis (likely post-streptococcal glomerulonephritis given the rash history, but current symptoms strongly suggest upper urinary tract infection). REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis, Urine Culture, CBC, Serum Creatinine. REQUEST IMAGES: Renal Ultrasound.
